description: CG-2 (COST-GATE-SPEC.md §3.3): the one price file for the cost gate. Each key is a US Gov monthly estimate for one billable item. Registry entries and AO ops name a key in cost_gate.cost_key; prices are never typed into entries. Figures are from the inventory (docs/context/cost-gate/RECURRING-COST-INVENTORY.md §5), Azure Retail Prices API, region usgovvirginia, pay-as-you-go, 730 hours a month. commercial_list = true where the Gov feed had no row. Per-use meters count as recurring (founder ruling CQ-2, 2026-10-31).

azure.bastion.standard.label: Azure Bastion Standard
azure.bastion.standard.basis: $0.362/h x 730; its public IP is priced separately

azure.vm.d2s_v5_windows.label: Workload VM (D2s v5 Windows + P10 disk)

azure.vm.mma_ingestion.label: Monitoring agent SecurityEvent ingestion
azure.vm.mma_ingestion.basis: 0.5 to 1 GB per VM per day at $2.88 to $5.38/GB; usage-based, no upper limit

azure.defender.paid_plans.label: Defender for Cloud paid plans (Storage, ARM, CSPM)
azure.defender.paid_plans.basis: Storage $12.26/account + ARM $6.28/subscription + CSPM about $5.11/resource (comm.); add $18.75 per VM for Servers P2

azure.log_analytics.workspace.label: Log Analytics workspace ingestion and retention
azure.log_analytics.workspace.basis: 10 GB/month: $2.88/GB after 5 GB free + retention past 31/90 days at $0.13/GB; usage-based, no upper limit

azure.sentinel.ingestion.label: Microsoft Sentinel pay-as-you-go analysis
azure.sentinel.ingestion.basis: 10 GB x $5.38/GB (includes LA ingestion); free sources $0; usage-based, no upper limit

azure.diagnostic_setting.label: Diagnostic setting into the workspace
azure.diagnostic_setting.basis: resource logs ingested at $2.88/GB; usage-based ($1 to $10 for four combined)

azure.diagnostic_setting.entra.label: Entra ID diagnostic setting into the workspace
azure.diagnostic_setting.entra.basis: sign-in and audit logs; covered only if the G5 data benefit applies in GCC High

azure.storage.immutability.label: WORM immutability on log storage
azure.storage.immutability.basis: storage cost only, but locked data must be paid for until it expires (a ratchet)

azure.resource_lock.ratchet.label: CanNotDelete lock on a billable resource
azure.resource_lock.ratchet.basis: $0 itself, but it stops people deleting a billable resource (a ratchet)

azure.keyvault.operations.label: Key Vault (Standard) operations
azure.keyvault.operations.basis: billed per use: about $0.03 per 10,000 operations; no standing charge. Per-use billing counts as recurring (CQ-2)

azure.keyvault.hsm_key.label: Key Vault HSM key version
azure.keyvault.hsm_key.basis: Advanced Key meter per enabled version + $0.188 per 10k operations

azure.keyvault.software_key.label: Key Vault software key
azure.keyvault.software_key.basis: billed per use (operations only); counts as recurring (CQ-2)

azure.network_watcher.flow_logs.label: NSG flow logs (retired by Microsoft, June 2025)

entra.id_governance.label: Entra ID Governance licence
entra.id_governance.basis: about $7 per user per month (comm.; Gov price not checked)
